Name: (CP) More Vanilla Seasonal Outfits
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/LNMjdrm.png[/img]﻿
This mod aims to give each character a seasonal outfit while respecting the original style of the game.

[b][size=3]Our main goal is for each character to have:[/size][/b]
- 1 outfit for each season
- 1 extra winter outfit for indoors/outdoors
- 1 outfit for the Flower Dance (singles only)
- 1 outfit for the Eve of the Spirits

[b][color=#f1c232]⚠️ Current State (Beta)⚠️[/color][/b]
[size=3]This is a beta version. Currently, only Jas, Abigail, and Krobus have seasonal outfits implemented. This version serves as the foundation for a much larger project, [b]but we need more people to create outfits! If you're interested in participating, contact me!![/b][/size][color=#cc0000][size=3][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QrbgCYt.png[/img]﻿
﻿[/b][/size][/color]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/uOzg6kR.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/kUVM452.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/VLojueu.gif[/img]﻿﻿﻿
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/WUJ5NYv.png[/img]﻿﻿[/b]
1- Unzip and add to your mod folder.

2- Done! :D

[b]Individual outfits can be enabled or disabled in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][/b]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y455WpB.png[/img]﻿
